create_multi_corpus_dataset: create a MultiCorpusSampledDataset from an OrderedDict of FairseqDataset instances with uniform sampling
build_custom_sampler: build a custom sampling function to pass into MultiCorpusSampledDataset for non-uniform dataset selection
collate_multi_corpus_batch: collate a mini-batch by sampling a dataset key and delegating to its collater function
review_index_mapping: review the _map_index_to_dataset method that wraps indices across datasets of different lengths
summarize_prefetch_support: summarize the prefetch and supports_prefetch logic that delegates to all underlying datasets
